data.narrative:
H3X is a Series A space and aerospace company that has raised $24.8M to date. Valuation is assessed against a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE.

Two quantitative methods are applicable. Stage-progression modeling uses the $24.8M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $50M. Peer-median anchoring examines three same-sector comparables at Series A/B stages—Cowboy Space at $2.0B (Series B), Aalyria at $1.3B (Series B), and Starcloud at $1.1B (Seed)—producing a median implied valuation of $1.3B. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied; the sector median is 27.4x across six public tickers, but H3X's revenue is not on file. This is typical for private companies at this stage.

The two applicable methods produce a wide triangulated range: $42M (low), $675M (median), and $1.5B (high). The 35x spread reflects stage and visibility uncertainty. Stage-progression suggests a floor grounded in capital deployment; peer-median suggests meaningful optionality relative to funded peers, though comparables span adjacent stages. Key uncertainties include whether H3X tracks toward Series B readiness (favoring the $1.3B anchor) or faces extended runway at current burn (favoring the $50M stage proxy).
